meta_description: In-stock Kubota Bottom Roller V0511-25104. Fits SVL65-2, SVL75, SVL90, SVL95-2S, SVL97-2. Wholesale pricing from Houston.
page_intro: The Kubota V0511-25104 bottom roller is a direct OEM replacement for Kubota SVL-series compact track loaders. This premium quality roller ensures smooth track operation and extended undercarriage life.
custom_fitment_notes: Verified fitment for all SVL65-2 through SVL97-2 models. 2 rollers required per machine.
wear_patterns: Uneven wear patterns across roller surface indicate misalignment. Flat spots suggest debris damage or overloading.
replacement_symptoms: Replace when: roller diameter below 4.5 inches; visible flat spots; excessive play in bearings; grinding noise during operation.
operating_environments: Performs well in construction, landscaping, agriculture, and forestry applications. Rated for rocky terrain and demolition work.
installation_guidance: 1. Raise machine on stands. 2. Remove track tension. 3. Remove mounting bolts. 4. Install new roller. 5. Torque to 65 ft-lbs. 6. Restore track tension.
maintenance_notes: Inspect every 250 hours. Clean debris from roller area. Check for oil leaks from seals.
oem_references: OEM Part: V0511-25104. Also known as: V0511-25100 (superseded)
terrain_applications: All terrain types: mud; rock; sand; concrete; asphalt. Heavy-duty construction rated.
expert_tips: Always replace rollers in pairs for even wear. Check idler and sprocket condition when replacing rollers.

installation_notes: Standard installation. Requires roller removal tool.
